name: robots/drcl-usc__hector_simulation
title: HECTOR humanoid Gazebo simulation
intro: HECTOR humanoid Gazebo simulation, adapted from drcl-usc/hector_simulation. It reads `read_model_states`; runs `send_left_hip_command`, `send_left_hip2_command`, `send_left_thigh_command`, `send_left_calf_command` and 6 more. `send_left_hip_command`: publish one unitree_legged_msgs/MotorCmd for the simulated left_hip joint. The receipt proves only that rosbridge accepted the publication; it does not prove that the controller applied it, that the joint moved, or that the robot is stable. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
